metaShifts.description: Initially boosted by attribute conversions, Universal heroes have seen a significant damage scaling nerf (0.7 to 0.45 per attribute). This rebalances their power, shifting the meta away from their previous dominance and forcing a re-evaluation of their itemization and strategic roles. While still viable, their raw damage output is diminished, making them less universally strong.

A strong emphasis on early game pressure is evident through buffs to base damage, early abilities, and the introduction of potent early items like Orb of Frost and Orb of Corrosion. These items provide accessible slows, healing reduction, and armor reduction, rewarding aggressive laning, early skirmishes, and heroes with innate sustain or defensive tools. The meta favors securing early advantages and snowballing.

Numerous reworks and additions to Aghanim's Scepter and Shard abilities create distinct and powerful mid-game power spikes. Identifying and leveraging these specific item timings is crucial for dictating game tempo, securing advantages, and enabling heroes to come online earlier with significant impact.

Roshan's new river movement and day/night cycle dependency, Tormentor's repositioning and gold bounty, and the introduction of Wandering Waters for high-speed rotations create a highly dynamic objective game. This emphasizes map awareness, coordinated rotations, and contesting key objectives, rewarding teams that can adapt quickly and control vision.

The complete overhaul of the neutral item system to a Madstone crafting mechanic removes RNG and introduces a new layer of strategic choice and farming optimization. Teams must efficiently clear camps and make informed crafting decisions, making neutral item power spikes predictable but requiring active management and resource allocation.

Significant nerfs to lifesteal and spell lifesteal against non-heroes (40% physical, 80% spell) fundamentally alter farming efficiency and sustain. This reduces the power of traditional jungle farming carries and spell lifesteal builds, pushing the meta towards more direct combat and less reliance on sustained creep healing, favoring heroes with innate sustain or burst.

Supports have received significant reworks to their utility and survivability, including unique ultimate abilities, invulnerability mechanics, and improved mana sustain. This allows them to have a more profound and resilient impact in teamfights, enabling aggressive plays and better sustain throughout the game.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Counterspell now reflecting spells by default is a massive defensive buff, making him incredibly resilient against magic burst and enabling more aggressive farming and engagement against spell-heavy lineups.

The reworks to Sanguivore and Bloodrage, particularly the pure damage on Blood Rite and max health pure damage on Bloodrage attacks, combined with the Sanguivore barrier, transform him into a potent and tanky damage dealer who can sustain through prolonged fights.

The new Aghanim's Shard for Laguna Blade, which converts a significant portion of its damage into an all-damage barrier, provides a crucial survivability boost, allowing her to commit to burst damage more safely.

Greevil's Greed's Aghanim's Scepter granting now being global makes him an unparalleled Aghs dispenser for the entire team. Additionally, Acid Spray and Unstable Concoction applying Corrosive Weaponry stacks significantly enhance his slow and damage reduction capabilities.

The new Aghanim's Scepter for Split Shot, allowing on-hit effects to apply to secondary attacks, unlocks immense damage potential with items like Mjollnir or Skadi, making her a late-game monster capable of devastating entire teams.

The comprehensive rework with the new facet system, allowing a chosen orb to reach level 10, and significant Scepter changes, offers unparalleled scaling and build diversity, making him incredibly adaptable and powerful in various team compositions.

The introduction of Nothl Projection as his new ultimate provides Dazzle with unparalleled positioning, invulnerability, and enhanced basic abilities, making him a highly versatile and impactful support capable of turning fights.

Tempest Double now spawning with current HP/Mana, Magnetic Field becoming point-targeted, and Flux/Spark Wraith unification are strong buffs that streamline his gameplay and increase his overall impact and reliability.

Raptor Dance now providing complete magic damage immunity for its duration is a huge defensive buff, allowing Kez to dive and engage with much greater safety against spell-heavy teams. Talon Toss dealing physical damage also improves his burst.

This new item provides early game slow, healing reduction, and armor reduction for a low cost. It's a perfect fit for aggressive laners and heroes looking to snowball early skirmishes, enhancing their kill potential and sustain denial.

The recipe change to include Sange makes it a more appealing item for strength and universal heroes, providing valuable strength, slow resistance, and health/lifesteal amplification. This enhances its utility as a late-game initiation and control tool.

Improved damage block and a significantly cheaper mana cost for its Disarm active make Heaven's Halberd a more accessible and potent defensive and offensive item, especially for offlaners needing to shut down right-click carries.

The addition of Break to Empower Spell is a massive buff, allowing spell-casting heroes to disable crucial passive abilities. Combined with increased bonus damage, it becomes a powerful tool against heroes reliant on their passives.

Decreased restock time and increased True Sight radius make vision control more accessible and effective. This benefits all roles, but especially supports who can maintain better map control and deward more efficiently.

Transmute now grants a Madstone Bundle, directly integrating Midas into the new neutral item crafting economy. This provides a reliable source of Madstone, allowing Midas users to accelerate their neutral item progression.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Increased illusion damage taken from Juxtapose and reduced Spirit Lance Scepter bounce count make his illusions more fragile and his overall damage output less reliable, impacting his late-game scaling and ability to overwhelm opponents.

Nerfs to Puckish's health/mana restoration, increased Dream Coil mana cost, and a talent rework that reduces Dream Coil cooldown reduction make Puck significantly weaker in terms of sustain and ultimate uptime, reducing his impact in prolonged engagements.

The removal of vision reduction from Void and shorter night duration on Void significantly reduce his ganking power and ability to control the map during night time, diminishing his signature strength and making him less oppressive.

Carry.explanation: Counterspell reflecting spells by default makes him incredibly resilient against magic burst, allowing him to farm more aggressively and engage in fights with greater confidence, especially against spell-heavy lineups.

The shift to pure damage on Blood Rite and Bloodrage attacks, combined with the Sanguivore barrier, makes him a formidable and tanky damage dealer who can sustain through fights, allowing him to frontline effectively.

Buffs to Vantage Point and Precision Aura scaling with Marksmanship significantly increase her damage output, especially from high ground, reinforcing her role as a potent ranged carry capable of melting targets.
Reduced cooldown on Time Walk provides more mobility and escape potential, making him harder to catch and more agile in fights, allowing for better Chronosphere setups and survivability.
The new Aghanim's Scepter for Split Shot, allowing on-hit effects to apply to secondary attacks, unlocks immense damage potential with items like Mjollnir or Skadi, making her a late-game monster.

Mid.explanation: The comprehensive rework with the new facet system, allowing a chosen orb to reach level 10, and significant Scepter changes, offers unparalleled scaling and build diversity, making him a top-tier mid.
Reduced mana cost on Feast of Souls and adjusted attack speed bonus make his early laning and farming more efficient, allowing him to hit power spikes faster and dominate the mid-game.
Increased damage on Aether Remnant provides stronger wave clear and burst damage, enhancing his ability to control the mid-lane and secure kills, making him a more aggressive presence.
Buffs to Tidebringer and Torrent talents significantly increase his area-of-effect damage and control, making him a more impactful mid-game teamfighter and wave clearer.
The increased AoE per Intelligence on Defilement makes him scale better into the mid and late game, improving his ability to deal sustained damage in teamfights and push objectives.

Offlane.explanation: Increased base damage, Battle Hunger damage, and reduced Culling Blade cooldown buffs make him a dominant force in the offlane, capable of securing early kills and snowballing his advantage.
Buffs to Fissure's damage and reduced mana cost improve his laning presence and initiation potential, allowing him to control the lane and set up ganks more effectively.
Increased base damage and improved stat gains make him more resilient and impactful in the offlane, allowing him to trade hits and farm more effectively while setting up Epicenters.
The new active component on Kraken Shell, doubling its block amount, provides a significant defensive boost, making him an even more durable frontliner in teamfights and harder to kill in lane.

Dauntless now affecting only Mars but with increased HP regen per enemy makes him a more self-sufficient and resilient frontliner, capable of sustaining through prolonged engagements and controlling teamfights.

SoftSupport.explanation: Her conversion to an Agility hero, coupled with base stat buffs and the Leap Shard rework (crit strikes), allows her to transition into a more potent damage dealer while retaining her strong roaming and ganking capabilities.

The Meat Hook Aghanim's Shard, providing bonus damage based on distance and cooldown reduction on ally hits, significantly enhances his utility as a playmaker and savior, allowing for more frequent and impactful hooks.

Reduced cooldown and mana cost on Impale, along with increased Mind Flare damage, make him a more frequent and impactful ganker and disabler from the soft support position, capable of securing early kills.

Increased enemy slow on Tether and the new Tether Shard, which deals damage and provides pseudo-lifesteal, make Io a more aggressive and sustainable support, capable of enabling strong lane partners and ganks.
Increased attack damage on Lil' Shredder improves her early game harass and last-hitting potential, making her a stronger presence in the soft support role and contributing more to lane dominance.

HardSupport.explanation: The introduction of Nothl Projection as his new ultimate provides Dazzle with unparalleled positioning, invulnerability, and enhanced basic abilities, making him a highly versatile and impactful hard support capable of turning fights.

The Fowl Play Aghanim's Shard, granting invulnerability and illusions, combined with the Shackles Aghanim's Scepter for Ether Shock spam, makes him a much more elusive and damaging support, capable of controlling fights and pushing objectives.
Reduced mana cost and increased mana drain on Sinister Gaze, along with buffs to Ice Spire, make him a more potent lane dominator and teamfight controller, especially against mana-dependent heroes.

Reduced cooldown and increased miss chance on Blinding Light, coupled with the new innate Special Reserve (cannot go below 75 mana), significantly improve his mana sustain and ability to spam spells, making him a stronger lane presence and teamfight disabler.

Increased damage on Decay and adjusted mana cost on Soul Rip enhance his early game aggression and sustain, making him a formidable hard support who can dominate the lane and contribute significantly to early teamfights.

Carry.explanation: Increased illusion damage taken from Juxtapose and reduced Spirit Lance Scepter bounce count make his illusions more fragile and his overall damage output less reliable, impacting his late-game scaling.

Nerfs to Wrath of God's bonus damage per Strength, reduced Warcry speed, and adjustments to Great Cleave significantly diminish his scaling, teamfight mobility, and overall damage output, making him less impactful.
Decreased damage reflected by Dispersion and increased cooldown on Shadow Step reduce her survivability and ability to engage in frequent teamfights, making her more vulnerable during engagements.

The inability to Infest Ancient creeps by default is a significant nerf to his farming efficiency and removes a key strategic option for ancient-bombing or quick map traversal, slowing his item progression.
Increased mana cost on Flak Cannon makes it harder for him to sustain his primary farming and teamfight ability, impacting his overall efficiency and ability to clear waves and deal damage.

Mid.explanation: Nerfs to Puckish's health/mana restoration, increased Dream Coil mana cost, and a talent rework that reduces Dream Coil cooldown reduction make Puck significantly weaker in terms of sustain and ultimate uptime, reducing his impact.

Decreased movement speed bonus from Fiery Soul and reduced Flame Cloak duration impact her mobility and sustained damage, making her more vulnerable and less effective in chasing down targets or escaping.
Increased mana cost and decreased jump radius on Arc Lightning, along with nerfs to Heavenly Jump, reduce his overall spell spam potential and mobility in teamfights, making him less oppressive.

Decreased spell lifesteal on Succubus and a nerf to Shadow Strike's Aghanim's Scepter bonus damage reduce her survivability and burst potential, making her less impactful in the mid-lane and teamfights.

The rework to his Level 10 talent for Overload's slow/attack speed, rather than damage, shifts his power away from burst, potentially making him less effective in a meta that favors aggression and quick kills.

Offlane.explanation: The removal of vision reduction from Void and shorter night duration on Void significantly reduce his ganking power and ability to control the map during night time, diminishing his signature strength.

Reduced movement speed per stack on Warpath and increased mana cost on Hairball make him less mobile and more mana-hungry, impacting his ability to chase and sustain in fights, making him easier to kite.
Increased mana cost and decreased pass damage on Chakram make his primary damage and mobility spell less efficient, impacting his ability to clear waves and engage, making him less dominant.
Decreased cast range and damage per second on Doom reduce his ability to lock down and burst key targets, making his ultimate less impactful and harder to land on priority heroes.

Duel no longer casting Press the Attack on victory by default is a significant nerf to her burst damage and self-sustain during duels, making her less effective at snowballing and sustaining through fights.

SoftSupport.explanation: Decreased self bonus speed from Track reduces his mobility and ability to position for ganks or escapes, making him less effective as a roaming support and easier to catch.
Reduced bonus speed for heroes from Astral Spirit makes his initiation and follow-up less potent, impacting his ability to set up kills and control teamfights effectively.

Decreased push distance and slow duration on Walrus Kick, along with the inability to cast it while Snowballed, significantly reduce his control and initiation potential, making his ganks less reliable.
The nerf to Cursed Crown's Aghanim's Shard (no longer reduces stun delay) makes her primary crowd control less reliable for quick disables, impacting her ability to secure kills and save allies.
Talent nerfs to Swashbuckle damage and Rolling Thunder duration reduce his overall damage output and teamfight impact from the soft support role, making him less of a threat.

HardSupport.explanation: Decreased slow duration on Crystal Nova and talent reworks that don't offer clear power spikes make her less effective at controlling lanes and teamfights, reducing her overall impact.
Smoke Screen no longer buffing allies significantly reduces his utility as a hard support, as he can no longer provide a team-wide defensive buff for his cores, diminishing his teamfight presence.

Talent reworks that replace Maledict burst damage with Voodoo Restoration heal are not clear buffs and may shift his focus away from burst, making him less impactful in aggressive lineups and more passive.
Decreased duration on Chilling Touch and nerfs to Cold Feet's stun duration (at early levels) reduce his overall control and damage output in teamfights, making his spells less impactful.

Winter's Curse no longer providing increased magic and pure damage bonus removes a significant damage amplification tool, making her ultimate less potent for bursting targets and reducing her teamfight contribution.
